title: Warped Fungus to Elytra
description: This resource pack turns Warped Fungus on a stick into an Elytra!!
body: This resource pack turns all Warped Fungus on a Stick into an Elytra texture, you can use this for anything you'd like! The only thing that sets it apart from a regular Elytra, is the fake one doesn't have purple text (or the rarity item name color).
